controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-07T05:45:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T06:55:00.000Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
| EVAL event_type = CASE(
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*", "LOGIN_ERROR",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN\"*", "LOGIN",
    message LIKE "*type=\"LOGOUT\"*", "LOGOUT",
    message LIKE "*type=\"REFRESH_TOKEN\"*", "REFRESH_TOKEN",
    "OTHER"
  )
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        login_errors = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGIN_ERROR",
        logins = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGIN",
        logouts = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "LOGOUT",
        refresh_tokens = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "REFRESH_TOKEN",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY event_type
